property_summary: For every admissible input, a successful call to C's fallback with any msg.value either reverts or, when it succeeds at a block number not divisible by 15, leaves address(c).balance increased by exactly 10 ether; the mutant accepts values other than 10 ether, so for such values it succeeds while the balance changes by an amount != 10 ether.
change_summary: Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether); statement so any value is accepted.
